# General feedback

This issue is public. Do not include confidential, personal, proprietary,
security-sensitive, or identifying information. Use the private vulnerability
reporting route in [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) for security reports.

## What are you responding to?

Name or link the template, feature, or experience if relevant. A version is
optional.

## Your feedback

What worked well or what would you change? You may provide a rating, but it is
not required.

## Optional context

Share only context needed to understand your feedback. Do not include project,
client, employer, or other identifying details.

Maintainers will assess the feedback, link actionable items to related work,
and communicate a disposition when available. Submission does not promise
implementation or a response time.
